main_pipeline_design_page.hero_title: Design of Main Gas Pipelines and GDS
main_pipeline_design_page.mg_desc: Main gas pipelines (MGP) and branch lines (lateral pipelines) with nominal diameter up to 1400 mm inclusive, with overpressure from 1.2 to 10 MPa inclusive (both single-line and multiple-line routing in utility corridors) for transmission of natural gas.
main_pipeline_design_page.grs_desc: A Gas Distribution Station (GDS) serves to reduce gas pressure from the main transmission pipeline to levels required for safe consumption, i.e., down to 1.2 MPa and lower.
main_pipeline_design_page.tasks_intro: In our practice, our Customers increasingly face the following challenges:
main_pipeline_design_page.task1_text: Construction of Main Gas Pipelines (MGP) or branch pipelines to a gas distribution station (GDS) with future connection capabilities for consumers.
main_pipeline_design_page.task2_text: Implementation of protective measures on operating main gas pipelines (installation of protective casings/sleeves).
main_pipeline_design_page.task3_text: Relocation (re-routing) of gas pipeline sections due to new construction inside the minimum permissible clearance safety zone.
main_pipeline_design_page.task4_text: Reconstruction, modernization, or retrofitting of GDS, valve stations, and main pipeline sections due to expiration of standard service life.
